## Treatments
- Hygiene & scaling (Hygiène & détartrage): Scaling, polishing and oral-hygiene coaching for healthy gums and fresh breath.
- Fillings & cavities (Soins & caries): Check-up, X-ray and cavity treatment with tooth-coloured aesthetic fillings.
- Aesthetics & whitening (Esthétique & blanchiment): Whitening, veneers and touch-ups for a bright, natural smile.
- Implants & crowns (Implants & prothèses): Replace a missing tooth: implants, crowns, bridges and custom dentures.
- Orthodontics & aligners (Orthodontie & aligneurs): Gently straighten teeth with clear aligners or a suitable brace.
- Children's dentistry (Dents des enfants): Reassuring first visits, prevention and gentle care for little ones.
- Dental emergency (Urgence dentaire): Toothache, abscess or broken tooth: we see you as soon as possible.
- Root canal & extraction (Dévitalisation & extraction): Root canal treatment, extractions and wisdom teeth, with gentle anaesthesia.
- Consultation / check-up (Consultation / bilan): A first appointment to assess your teeth and plan clear treatment.

## About the clinic
Dr. Chraibi's dental clinic is located in Saada, Marrakech. It welcomes adults, children and visitors to Marrakech for everyday dental care, scaling and oral hygiene, whitening and smile aesthetics, implants and crowns, orthodontics with clear aligners, root canal treatment, extractions and dental emergencies. Consultations in Arabic, Darija, French and English, Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm and Saturday 9am to 1pm.

## FAQ
- How do I book? Tap “Book”, choose the treatment, day and time, then send your request on WhatsApp. The clinic confirms quickly.
- Do you see emergencies? Yes. For strong pain, an abscess or a broken tooth, choose “Dental emergency” or call the clinic directly.
- How much does treatment cost? It depends on your situation. After the exam, Dr. Chraibi gives you a clear quote before any treatment.
- How often should I have a scaling? Usually every 6 months, sometimes more often if your gums bleed or if you smoke.
- Do you treat children? Yes, from their very first teeth, with visits designed to put them at ease.
- Which languages do you speak? Arabic, Darija, French and English.
- Where is Dr. Chraibi's dental clinic? In Saada, Marrakech (Google Maps code MXGJ+7C). The “Directions” button opens the route in Google Maps.
- Is the clinic open on Saturday? Yes, on Saturday from 9am to 1pm. On weekdays, Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm. Closed on Sunday.
